series.title: Abandon: 100 Nuki Shinai to Derarenai Fushigi na Kyoushitsu
series.description:
Abandon: 100 Nuki Shinai to Derarenai Fushigi na Kyoushitsu follows Abe Tomonori, a student whose hidden interest in adult videos becomes the starting point for a bizarre supernatural situation at school. During a remedial class, his classmates discover what he has been viewing on his smartphone. Before they can make sense of the situation, a mysterious entity known as Ruler emerges from the device and traps the group inside their classroom. The only way out is to fulfill an impossible condition involving the production of adult videos.

Abe is unexpectedly placed in the role of director, while his classmates—including Arisa Katagiri, Hikaru Tsumura, Miho Sonoda, and the enigmatic Ruler—become central to the strange scenario. Ruler possesses supernatural abilities that make it clear that ordinary resistance will not release them, transforming what initially appears to be an absurd classroom incident into a tightly controlled supernatural game. The group is provided with various filming tools and a script capable of dictating what happens during the production, further blurring the boundary between the virtual premise and their physical surroundings.

The title combines a school setting with supernatural elements, mind-control themes, and a forced-game premise. Its central mystery revolves around the identity and purpose of Ruler, the rules governing the classroom, and whether Abe and his classmates can satisfy the conditions required to escape. The story is adapted from Rakujin's original work and is presented as an adult OVA centered on a small group of classmates caught in an increasingly unusual situation. Rather than following a conventional school story, the series turns the classroom into an isolated setting where the characters must deal with supernatural rules, shifting power dynamics, and the consequences of the mysterious application that initiated the entire ordeal.

series.about_text:
## Overview
Abandon: 100 Nuki Shinai to Derarenai Fushigi na Kyoushitsu is a supernatural adult OVA set almost entirely around a mysterious classroom from which a group of students cannot escape. The story begins when Abe Tomonori's smartphone becomes the source of an impossible situation, bringing the strange entity Ruler into the classroom and imposing a bizarre set of rules on the trapped students. Adapted from Rakujin's original work, the series combines school-life elements with supernatural powers, a forced-game premise, and shifting relationships between the characters. The isolated classroom becomes the central stage for the story as the group attempts to understand Ruler's demands and find a way to regain their freedom.

## Production & Presentation
The OVA is based on Rakujin's original work and is associated with Rabbit Gate, which is identified as the studio on HentaiEngSub and as the animation work on AniDB. AniDB also credits character design to 川上枝太郎 and 蒼井珠磨. The production uses the confined classroom as its principal setting, allowing the supernatural premise and character interactions to drive the presentation. Its visual identity is centered on the cast and the unusual rules imposed by Ruler, while the adaptation retains the adult-game/manga-oriented premise of the original work.

## Themes & Style
Abandon combines supernatural school drama with a closed-room game structure and adult-oriented themes. Its central ideas revolve around confinement, control, coercion, curiosity, and the loss of normal boundaries when an ordinary classroom is subjected to supernatural rules. The mysterious Ruler creates an atmosphere of uncertainty, while the characters' relationships and changing power dynamics drive the story forward. The school setting contrasts with the increasingly abnormal situation, giving the OVA a surreal tone. The combination of supernatural abilities, mind-control elements, a forced-game premise, and an ensemble cast gives the title a distinctly unconventional style.

## Recommended For
Viewers interested in supernatural adult OVAs with a school setting, closed-room scenarios, and unusual game-like premises may find Abandon particularly appealing. It is suited to audiences who enjoy stories built around mysterious rules, supernatural control, ensemble character dynamics, and a single confined location rather than conventional action-driven plots. Fans of adaptations based on adult games or manga may also appreciate its focused premise.

series.description: An experienced exorcist enters an abandoned school building where an ominous supernatural presence has been waiting in the darkness. The place appears forgotten, but the spiritual force inside it is anything but weak. At the center of the haunting is Hanako-san, a school spirit who has accumulated tremendous spiritual energy over many years. The familiar legend has been transformed into a much more formidable presence, and the exorcist soon realizes that he is facing an opponent whose supernatural abilities cannot be treated as an ordinary haunting. The encounter begins as an investigation into a dangerous spirit but develops into a direct confrontation between the exorcist and Hanako-san. Deep within the old school, the atmosphere becomes increasingly oppressive as the two are drawn into a struggle shaped by spiritual power, supernatural abilities, and physical dominance. Hanako-san uses her unusual powers to challenge and entrap the exorcist, while he attempts to withstand the pressure of a spirit whose strength has grown far beyond what the traditional school legend might suggest. The story keeps its focus on the isolated school, the mysterious history surrounding Hanako-san, and the escalating conflict between the supernatural presence and the person who has entered the building to confront it. Rather than treating Hanako-san simply as an apparition, the narrative presents her as an active and powerful force capable of turning the encounter into a serious test for the exorcist. Her accumulated spiritual energy becomes an important part of the premise and explains why the situation is considerably more dangerous than an ordinary paranormal investigation. Across its four-episode structure, the series develops this central encounter through a combination of haunted-school atmosphere, supernatural fantasy, and adult-oriented genre elements. The contrast between a familiar Japanese school-spirit legend and the unusually powerful interpretation of Hanako-san provides the story with its distinctive identity. The exorcist's attempt to confront her powers forms the central narrative thread, while the abandoned setting reinforces the sense of isolation and uncertainty surrounding the encounter. The result is a compact supernatural story focused on Hanako-san's mysterious abilities, the exorcist's confrontation with her, and the dark atmosphere of the school.

However, the rogue machines prove to be far more dangerous than she anticipated. Their mechanical bodies have been equipped with unusual weapons, including tentacle-like mechanisms capable of restraining their targets and subjecting them to intense stimulation. Resta's technical knowledge and determination initially allow her to confront the machines, but the increasingly aggressive attacks make the situation difficult to control. The story follows her struggle against these corrupted machines as she attempts to overcome the threat and restore order to her town. The conflict places the skilled mechanic in a situation where mechanical technology has become an unexpected source of danger. Alongside its science-fiction-inspired mechanical premise, the OVA incorporates fantasy and magical-girl elements, creating a distinctive setting for Resta's confrontation. The narrative remains focused on Resta and the rogue robots rather than developing a large supporting cast, allowing the central mechanical crisis to drive the story.
